verdict.rationale: The docs show natural-language interaction surfaces inside Teams: Copilot Chat is available in Teams and works over work data from Microsoft Graph. Developers can also build agents users chat with, with prompt starters and slash commands. However, the evidence does not show users operating Teams itself (e.g., creating channels or scheduling meetings) through natural language without custom agent development; the automation shown is mostly via Graph APIs and code. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of core Teams actions, depth on what Copilot Chat in Teams can actually do, independent or hands-on corroboration.
